verdict.rationale: Xero ships AI features like JAX for reconciliation, invoicing via plain-language commands, and automated bill-data extraction, plus vague messaging about 'instant answers about cash flow, profit trends and financial health' — showing genuine in-product AI-generated insights/suggestions. However, evidence is mostly marketing copy without hands-on/independent corroboration or detail on the depth/accuracy of these insights. missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification of insight quality, detail on what 'instant answers' actually surfaces, broader coverage beyond reconciliation/invoicing/bill-entry use cases.
